name: One Person's Trash
summary: A piece of metal in the Tainted Foothills may still interest an engineer. You seek someone who can recognize it and know who might salvage it.

sections.title: A Piece of Metal
sections.body: Among the rusting metal in the Tainted Foothills, you find an engineering component that looks shinier than the rest. Anything else useful seems to have been picked clean. You look for someone nearby who might recognize the piece or know who wants it.

sections.title: The Old War Machines
sections.body: The solid cast metal once went into the war machines that ravaged these hills. Survivors and beasts have reclaimed many pieces, but this one may be sought by a particular engineer.

faq.answer: You found a shinier engineering component among rusting metal in the Tainted Foothills.

faq.q: Where should I look for someone who wants it?
faq.answer: You search the Tainted Foothills for someone interested in the metallic piece.

faq.q: What was this metal used for?
faq.answer: The solid cast metal was used to build the war machines that ravaged the hills years ago.
Survivors and beasts have reclaimed many of the pieces.

faq.q: Is this piece different from the others?
faq.answer: The person who recognizes it says this piece is different and may still be sought by a particular engineer.
